Finsler metric measure spaces encompass a richer set of geometric tensors compared to Riemannian manifolds (cf. [11]). It is important to emphasize that (1.1) is not merely quasilinear elliptic equation; as the underlying space is an anisotropic and asymmetric manifold\_ Within this framework; we establish the following theorem
